comments.author: Amir
comments.post_title: IELTS Speaking: topics for video lessons
comments.text:
Hi Simon,

I need to thank you for your website and the helps that I got from it. I am very happy that I found your website because in less than a month I was able to make myself ready for speaking test. I took the test three times, first time and second time I got 5.5 in speaking. But the third time I got 6.5, thanks to your valuable resources.

I had difficulty in both expressing ideas and fluency, and I had no idea how to improve until I used your samples. The method I used for speaking was memorizing your speaking answer samples. I memorized and repeated them many times deep down in my mind. This helped me in so many ways, first whenever I wanted to speak (even normal daily conversation) easily I used some expressions. Secondly, I became more confident to speak up! finally, It helped me to develop my ability to bring ideas to life!

You were really helpful and I really enjoyed visiting your website.

I do appreciate your helps to all English learners.

Cheers,

body:
I haven't been able to make any video lessons for a while, mainly because I've been in the process of moving house. Now that I'm getting myself organised again, I'm planning to start making a series of video lessons for the speaking test.

If you've taken the speaking test recently, please share your question topics (for all 3 parts) in the comments below. I'll then be able to make my lessons as up-to-date as possible. Thanks!
